title: A task's completion callback still running as the kit's close begins is the kit's running work: the close gives it its grace, and the callback returns within it
notes: Python: tests/tasks/test_cancelled_delegation.py; tasks/memory.py _complete (the callback held as the kit's channel work). The callback holds at a gate once called; the close starts, then the gate opens, well within the close's 5 s grace. A close whose cut ends the callback at once (roomkit) tells the grace apart from no grace; one that lets a cut callback go on through its unwind (roomkit-rs drops it only past the unwind) ends the same with no grace, so there the grace is not told apart. Cited in part: the cut once the grace passed is tasks/a-completion-callback-still-running-past-the-close-s-grace-is-cut; a callback that ignores its cut, abandoned once the unwind ran out, and the log line that names it are not observed.
